blocks.question: Q1 (SBI PO Mains 2025). A completes work in 20 days. B takes 2x% more days than A, C takes x% more days than B. Time taken by C alone = sum of times taken by A and B alone. Find time for all three together to complete 11× the work.

steps.explanation:
Time(B)=20(1+2x%), Time(C)=20(1+2x%)(1+x%). Given Time(C)=Time(A)+Time(B):
(1+2x%)(1+x%) = 2(1+x%) → 1+2x% = 2 → x=50.
B=40 days, C=60 days. LCM(20,40,60)=120 units work. Efficiencies: A=6, B=3, C=2 → combined=11/day.
Time for 11× the work = 11×120/11 = 120 days.
